moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The world's largest open-access arts festival, Edinburgh Fringe, begins today, bringing three weeks of comedy, theatre, music, and more to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive! The Fringe Festival officially starts today, transforming the city into a global stage for arts and culture for the next three weeks. What are you seeing first?

angles.name: Scottish Spotlight
angles.copy: It's here! The Edinburgh Fringe Festival kicks off today! Get ready for an incredible August packed with the best in comedy, theatre, and music right here in Scotland. Where are you heading?

moments.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo Begins
moments.blurb: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo, a spectacular display of music, marching, and dance on the Edinburgh Castle Esplanade, commences today and runs until August 29.

angles.name: Tattoo Excitement
angles.copy: Pipes, drums, and an incredible spectacle! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo starts today, promising breathtaking performances against the stunning backdrop of Edinburgh Castle. Don't miss it!

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: A Call to Gather! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo begins its incredible run today. Experience world-class music, dance, and military displays at Edinburgh Castle. Truly unmissable!

moments.title: The Hundred Final at Lord's
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament culminates with its men's and women's finals at Lord's Cricket Ground on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Hundred finals are set for Lord's on Sunday 16th August. Who are you backing to lift the trophy in the men's and women's competitions?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Hope
angles.copy: Fingers crossed for Welsh Fire! The Hundred finals are this Sunday, August 16th. Can our Welsh team make it to Lord's and bring home the title? Catch all the action!

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut in London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic hip hop festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, featuring world-class performances.

angles.name: Hip Hop Weekend
angles.copy: Big news for London! The legendary Roots Picnic festival lands at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend (Aug 8-9) for its UK debut. Get ready for some serious hip hop vibes!

angles.name: Crystal Palace Bowl
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing! The first ever UK Roots Picnic is happening this Saturday and Sunday. Who are you excited to see at this historic London event?

moments.title: Premier League Transfer Window Active
moments.blurb: The Premier League summer transfer window is in full swing, with clubs making significant signings ahead of the new season, and remains open until September 1.

angles.name: Transfer Talk
angles.copy: The summer transfer window is heating up! Who's made the best signings so far, and which big names are still on the move before the September 1st deadline?

angles.name: Club Specific Deals
angles.copy: Another day, another transfer! Your club still active in the market? With the window open until September 1st, expect more twists and turns before the season kicks off!

moments.title: Ben Gibbard (Death Cab for Cutie) Turns 50
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, lead vocalist and guitarist for Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service, celebrates his 50th birthday on August 11.

angles.name: Indie Icon at 50
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 50th birthday to indie legend Ben Gibbard on August 11! From Death Cab for Cutie to The Postal Service, his voice has defined a generation. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Joe Jackson Turns 72
moments.blurb: Influential English singer-songwriter and musician Joe Jackson celebrates his 72nd birthday on August 11.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson on August 11! From 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' to 'Steppin' Out', his unique sound captured the late 70s and 80s. What's your favourite Joe Jackson song?

moments.title: Mike Hugg (Manfred Mann) Turns 84
moments.blurb: Mike Hugg, co-founder and drummer/vibraphonist of the legendary band Manfred Mann, celebrates his 84th birthday on August 11.

source.l: Aug. 11 in Music History: Happy birthday, Ben Gibbard - The Current

angles.name: 60s Beat Maker
angles.copy: A huge happy 84th birthday to Mike Hugg of Manfred Mann on August 11! His drumming helped define the sound of the swinging sixties. What's your favourite Manfred Mann hit?

moments.title: Ali Shaheed Muhammad (A Tribe Called Quest) Turns 56
moments.blurb: DJ and producer Ali Shaheed Muhammad, best known as a member of the iconic hip hop group A Tribe Called Quest, celebrates his 56th birthday on August 11.

source.l: Aug. 11 in Music History: Happy birthday, Ben Gibbard - The Current

angles.name: Hip Hop Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the legendary Ali Shaheed Muhammad from A Tribe Called Quest on August 11! His influence on hip hop and dance music is undeniable. What's your favourite ATCQ track?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21, marking the start of another thrilling football campaign.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: Only two weeks to go! The Premier League returns on Friday, August 21st. Who are you backing for the title, and who's facing an uphill battle this season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready! The Premier League kicks off on August 21st. Which opening weekend fixture are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: The twin Reading & Leeds Festivals, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C., take place from August 27-30.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Reading & Leeds Festivals, August 27-30! With a massive line-up across rock, pop, and more, who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. – just some of the huge names heading to Reading & Leeds later this month! Are you ready for the ultimate bank holiday weekend?

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns
moments.blurb: One of the UK's largest electronic music festivals, Creamfields, is set to electrify Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27-30.

angles.name: Dance Music Mecca
angles.copy: Creamfields is just around the corner! Get ready for four days of the best electronic music from August 27-30 in Cheshire. Who's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: From Calvin Harris to Swedish House Mafia, Creamfields is bringing the biggest names in dance to Daresbury later this month. Are you heading to the ultimate electronic music party?
